channel.title: IPv6 on bramp.net
channel.description: Recent content in IPv6 on bramp.net

description.p: I’m more excited than I should be, but today I noticed that Comcast has enabled IPv6 on my home internet connection. All my devices in the home have picked up one or more Internet routable IPv6 addresses. Here are a few screen shots:

figcaption.h4: IPv6 my website (thanks to Amazon AWS)
even my Android phone has IPv6!

description.p: So this is very cool, but this has identified a few issues. The most important of which, is that I had previously been using my NAT as a firewall, protecting all devices on the internal network. However, now they all have external IP addresses, they are effectively open to the Internet and un-firewalled. That’s not an issue for my Linux machines, but could be problematic for my girlfriend’s Windows laptop, and my various embedded devices (phones, tablets, and TVs).
